header.title: Shine
header.description: Animated gleam over a surface: an image, a card or a tile. `effect="sweep"` passes a diagonal band and `effect="burst"` shoots sparkles from the center. `duration` is how long the motion lasts and `interval` is how often it repeats.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the gleam and the code. With `trigger="hover"`, hover over it.
playground.label: Limited edition

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Wrap any node with `Shine`. By default the band passes every 4 seconds, diagonally from top left to bottom right.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` picks the band color: `light` (white), `gold` or `accent`. It stands out more on dark backgrounds.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` controls how opaque the band is: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`.

burst.title: Burst
burst.description: `effect="burst"` shoots sparkles from the center outward. It uses the same `tone`, `interval` and `trigger` as the band. A shorter `duration` makes it snappier.

hover.title: On hover
hover.description: `trigger="hover"` fires the gleam on hover or when something inside gets keyboard focus, and repeats it every `interval` while it stays there. Try it with Tab.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: `interval` is the time between the start of each pass. If it's shorter than `duration`, it waits for the previous one to end. With `0`, it repeats as soon as it ends.

angle.title: Angle
angle.description: `angle` changes the band direction in degrees. `90` makes it vertical and `180`, horizontal.

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: `radius` clips the gleam corners. Match it to the content radius so the band doesn't spill out.

card.title: On a card
card.description: `block` stretches `Shine` to the container width. The content doesn't change: buttons and links inside keep working because the band doesn't take clicks.

texts.title: Studio plan
texts.subtitle: Highlight a paid tier
texts.body: Add a gleam to a card, an image or any surface without touching the content.

color.title: Custom color
color.description: `color` replaces `tone` with any CSS color. Prefer tokens, like `var(--gem-palette-tertiary-200)`.

control.title: Enable and pause
control.description: `isActive={false}` hides the gleam without unmounting the content. `isPaused` freezes the animation where it is.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Shine accepts <div> attributes except color, which is the band color here. They go to the root along with ref. style is merged with --gem-shine-duration, --gem-shine-angle, --gem-shine-strength and --gem-shine-color. Your onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave, onFocus and onBlur run before the internal ones.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.decorative: The band and sparkles have aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: they aren't announced and don't block clicks.
a11y.motion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the gleam isn't shown, in JavaScript or in CSS.
a11y.hover: trigger="hover" also responds to focus on an inner element. Shine isn't focusable: put a button or link inside if you want it to fire from the keyboard.
a11y.content: Don't use the gleam as the only signal of something important: pair it with text, like a "New" badge.
a11y.flashing: Avoid very short intervals with intensity="lg" on large surfaces: flashing more than three times per second can bother people with photosensitivity.
a11y.pause: If the gleam repeats forever on something important, offer a way to pause it with isPaused or turn it off with isActive.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root. Defines the variables and clips the content. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.block: Applied with `block`. Takes the full width.
rules.gleam: Gleam layer, with `aria-hidden`. Receives `classNames.gleam`. Remounts on every pass.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Shine's own variables. `intensity`, `duration` and `angle` write them as inline style, so plain CSS doesn't override them: use the props, `style` or `!important` utilities.

items.--gem-shine-duration: Duration of each pass. Set by `duration`.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Shine also accepts `<div>` attributes (see Inheritance). Times are in milliseconds.

items.trigger: `always` repeats forever; `hover` only while hovered or with focus inside.
items.effect: `sweep` is the diagonal band; `burst`, sparkles from the center.
items.interval: Time between the start of each pass. Never shorter than `duration`. With `0` it repeats as soon as it ends.
items.isActive: With `false` hides the gleam without unmounting the content.
